limitations: This scan documents a parliamentary draft and discussion, not a promulgated boundary annex. Legislative content is distinct from proof of its final adoption.
The printed page number was not confidently identified; PDF leaf 317 is one-based and must not be substituted for printed pagination.
The OCR layer is useful for searching but visually defective; the visible page is the evidence and no new OCR was performed.
The original Annex VI and intervening territorial acts of 1959-1963 remain unverified.
